name: ops-release-loop
description: The release loop: issue-triggered, CI-gated, no mid-flow human approval. Labelling a `release <version>` issue `ops/auto-release` makes it command the repo's `ops-release` through plan → cut → publish → sync, driving CI green in between and gating on an Opus pre-publish review against a repo-overridable checklist (a BLOCK files an issue, notifies, and de-labels rather than shipping). Every release mechanic — version files, changelog, tagging, publish target, back-merge — belongs to `ops-release`, which is ALWAYS repo-provided; this loop only orchestrates and gates, and never calls `ops-branching`. Bundles the release-reviewer agent, the default review checklist, and the `sync` contract. Requires ops-capabilities and github-ops.
